title: Tag pose and variant sets in the entity catalogue so previews stop fake-cycling
tier_reason: Data edits behind an already-shipped schema; reversible in one commit, but two entries touch how Daniel's gallery previews look, which is a taste call worth one look.
ask:
Commit 687e532 gave hq/data/entities.json an `anims` field: named animations as ordered index lists into the entity's `frames` pool, with `kind: "stills"` for pose/variant sets that must never play as a cycle (hq/README.md documents the schema; hq/static/sprite.js and app.js already honor it). The farmer, neighbour, bot and chicken are done.

Remaining entities whose flat frame list is not actually an animation:
- obstacles (8 different rocks/trees — variants)
- interior_walls (wall / window — variants)
- terrain_dirt (2 tile variants)
- sprinkler (idle / spraying — two states)
- mole (mound / emerging / surfaced — a state ladder)

Tag each with a single stills anim (or split into named states where that reads better in the editor). **Crops are done, and the judgement recorded here was wrong.** This item used to say "leave crops as a loop" on the grounds that a crop growing reads well as a cycle. The designer overruled it on 2026-09-08 with the test that settles it: *"the player never sees the different plant stages animate."* A flipbook of states the player meets days apart invents an animation the game does not have, and worse, it hides the very failure the page exists to catch — the eye reads change from the frames swapping rather than from the drawings differing. The three crops are now tagged `kind: "ladder"` and render as a labelled contact sheet. Apply the same test to the mole rather than asking what looks nice: does a player ever see those three pictures in sequence? Verify each edited entity's editor page (#/sprite/...) and the gallery still render.

Same-pass guard while you are in the file: the catalogue mirrors game code by hand (player/player.gd::_load_sprites and friends), and anims now encode row meanings, so a wrong rect silently mislabels an editor. If HQ's broken-reference checker is the right home, add a geometry sanity check: every frames rect within its sheet's PNG bounds, every anims index within the frames pool.
first_action: Read hq/README.md on the anims schema, then tag the pose/variant entities in hq/data/entities.json and verify their editor pages render.
